notes.title: New Game: Gunlocked 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735951/3c6737ced951c49e81af9ab5560123f9047c6870.gif[/img]
I’m excited to finally announce Gunlocked 2! Making the original roguelite shoot ‘em up was such a formative moment in my life that I knew if I was ever going to make a sequel it had to be special. For a while, however, I wasn’t sure how. So I’ve spent the past few years experimenting with various spins on the formula, learning what works, and what doesn’t. And after a few extra twists and turns in the journey, it’s finally here (almost).

[b]Wishlist it today: [/b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3492830/Gunlocked_2]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3492830/Gunlocked_2[/url]

The first game’s success was a welcome surprise that changed my life, but it was limited by its originally modest ambitions. When tens of thousands of players joined the fight against the Swarm, the game expanded beyond anything I previously planned. But it could only reach so far outside its original constraints. A sequel was the only way to make things bigger and better. 

Gunlocked 2 is, planned from the start to be, a premium indie game that can stand toe-to-toe with the best action RPGs, shmups, and roguelites. It has everything you loved about the original, and many improvements to the formula based on years of feedback.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735951/a0d9b0afdfb759438d0162d13f8ca63d7a32aefe.gif[/img]

It's the biggest, and most ambitious FromLefcourt game yet. 

And you can help make it even bigger, and even better. A Kickstarter campaign is now underway to fund a more expansive version of the sequel that will deliver extra content and challenges from day 1!

[b]Support the Kickstarter:[/b] [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/fromlefcourt/1010217824?ref=6b9sev&token=422002d2]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/fromlefcourt/1010217824?ref=6b9sev&token=422002d2[/url]

Gunlocked 2 will launch into Early Access on Steam for PC in Q3 2025, proudly keeping the FromLefcourt tradition of heavy community involvement. Unlike more recent games, I expect a long development period full of huge content updates that will dwarf the original in scope and spectacle!

[h2]About Gunlocked 2[/h2]
Movement is your weapon. A sci-fi action roguelite and shmup combined, in Gunlocked 2 you'll pilot and upgrade a state-of-the-art warship against endless waves of deadly aliens. Deep customization, branching paths, truly novel weapons, and tons of unlockables offer endless replayability set against the infinity of outer space.

[h2]What's New in the Sequel?[/h2]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735951/ecd05acd3403f8f7ade5315b02fc68ab1213c144.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Expanded Customization:[/b] 18 unique pilots, customizable warships with their own strengths and styles, and 100+ infinitely stackable upgrades offer new creative freedom.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735951/58d7ac874887edfc39ff90ae3462a82296c894e7.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Branching Paths: [/b]Warp gates let you seamlessly jump to different zones that offer unique battles and rewards. Every run offers new choices!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735951/cb39cef4390d1d71e7e1d93f0840c3c146f79eb2.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Refined Control: [/b]A new dodge ability gives players more control. And 360-degree analog movement brings Gunlocked out of the retro era and firmly into the present.
[*] [b]Play How You Want: [/b]Play for 2 minutes or 20, Gunlocked 2 fits perfectly into whatever free time you have, then save and resume later. But death is still permanent!
[*] [b]Modular Difficulty: [/b]Difficulty modifiers now come in multiple levels, and can make the game as hard or as easy as you'd like.
[*] [b]Glorious Pixel Art: [/b]Huge, full color sprites with detailed animations make every bullet, bomb, and laser explode with style.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735951/490cb00b0227afbb38bdf6cc98ca35c17ce4ef00.gif[/img]
[/list]

[b]More details on the Steam Store Page:[/b] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3492830/Gunlocked_2]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3492830/Gunlocked_2[/url]

notes.title: Patch 1.0
notes.content:
[h1]Cosmic Raze 1.0 – We Have Liftoff![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150731/41ae7ace4c78d08e1bf89aadc6f6a421c4cc6531.gif[/img]

Well, here we are. Cosmic Raze has reached 1.0! Thanks for all of the feedback along the way, and to my Patreon supporters for lending an extra helping hand.

I’m happy with how this little experiment turned out, and hope you’ve enjoyed it too. I’ll be keeping an eye on any lingering bugs, but otherwise I consider this project complete. 

Stay tuned for what’s next!

[h2]Features[/h2]
    • 14 new augments to unlock and equip
    • 2 new active powers to unlock and equip
    • 6 new, harder difficulties
    • Cosmic Daze: A brand new easy mode that gives you some serious advantages
    • 20 new achievements
    • The Data Codex: Track your unlocks, equipped weapons, and achievement progress

[b]Balance[/b]
[i]Notes: A lot of changes here focus on energy gain. In older versions of the game, it cost a lot more to build weapons, so energy gain was higher.[/i]

    • (Meta) Max experience needed for unlocks has been reduced to 350 from 450. Experience needed 
      for your first several unlocks has also been reduced.
    • (Meta) On higher difficulties, long range strikes against your weapons will no longer happen in the   
      first 30 seconds of a wave.
    • (Gamepad) When playing with a gamepad, you now have an extra 1.5 seconds to collect gold bars
    • (Power) Column Bomb has an 11 second cooldown, down from 12
    • (Power Backup Battery: Grants +60 energy, down from 100
    • (Augment) Scrap Zap now gives +20 energy when you scrap a weapon, up from 10
    • (Augment) Hot Potato now states that it triggers when mines detonate, not bombs. Increased the 
      chance to trigger by 5%.
    • (Breakthrough) Efficiency: +2/3/4% energy gain in battle, down from 3/4/5%
    • (Breakthrough Jump Start: +5/8/12 max and starting energy, down from +10/15/20
    • (Synergy) Defense: Mines will now detonate after 5 seconds, or when enemies are close enough. Up 
      from 3 seconds.
    • (Weapon) Far Light: Removed the energy gain. This was a relic from when it was a Harvester type 
      weapon.
    • (Weapon) Sun Power: Gives 3/5 energy, down from 5/8

[b]Quality of Life[/b]
    • Added a small victory animation when you beat the game
    • All drones now have basic idle animations
    • (Power) Last Resort now states correctly that it deals 50 damage to 5 targets per weapon destroyed. 
      Previously said 3.

[b]Bugs[/b]
    • Removed a debug feature that caused f2 to reset the game and f4 to close it
    • Upgraded weapons should now always have an upgrade arrow when placed on the battlefield
    • Fixed an issue that prevented certain difficulty modifiers from being applied when loading a game
    • Fixed an issue where the defense synergy mines were not triggering the Hot Potato augment
    • Fixed an issue where certain upgrades were being unlocked before they should be
    • Fixed an issue with certain non-standard weapons reducing your total weapon count when destroyed 
      even though they don't count toward your total weapon count when created
    • If you activate your power at the end of a round without using it, it will properly deactivate before the 
      next round.
    • (Augment) Support Strike was not always counting every lock-on weapon 
    • (Augment) Support Strike was sometimes counting weapons not in reserve
    • (Augment) Hot Potato now correctly triggers with all mines from weapons, augments, powers, and 
      synergies 
    • (Weapon) Sunsplitter will not longer be destroyed too soon if damaged when no valid enemies are 
      nearby
    • (Mouse) Fixed an issue where moving the mouse too quickly over multiple selections could cause text 
      to become misaligned
    • (Mouse) Fixed an issue in options menu when attempting to change resolutions 
    • (Mouse) Fixed an issue where clicking in the options menu when not over a choice would highlight 
      and lock the selection until the player right clicked to cancel
    • (Mouse) When moving between certain sections of the game, you should no longer need to click to 
      make the custom mouse cursor reappear 
    • (Gamepad) You can now end the selected option in the options menu by confirming or canceling

notes.title: Release Update
notes.content:
Hey, everyone! It's been a little while since the last big update, and I wanted to keep everyone informed on what's going on.

Late last year while working on patch 0.90, I realized it would be easier to combine it with the launch patch, and just add everything all at once. Since I was adding the codex to track your unlocks and achievements in 0.90 it seemed silly to immediately have to go back and update the codex with new augments and achievements in the patch after.

Things were going smoothly on that front until the winds and fires broke out here in California. I lost power for several days, and ended up staying with friends for a week in case of an evacuation (I live in Pasadena). I'm slowly getting back on track, but it has been hard to look away from the news for a while. Still, I'm so fortunate that I only lost power and some groceries, when so many lost so much.

The hardest thing about being a solo game developer is that if I can't work, there's nobody to pick up the slack. But I'm still hoping to release the launch patch (0.90 and 1.00 combined) before the end of the month, and most of the content is done. There's still quite a bit of bug fixing and polish left though. 

Here's a preview of what to expect:

[b]Key Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] 14 new augments
[*] 2 new active powers
[*] 5 New Difficulties: 6-10
[*] 20 new achievements
[*] The Data Codex: Track your unlocks, equipped weapons, and achievements
[*] Various visual updates, balance changes, and bug fixes
[/list]

Thanks for your understanding (hopefully).

notes.title: Patch 0.80
notes.content:
[h3]Patch 0.80: Shiny![/h3]

Today's patch is all about smoothing down rough edges. While not the most exciting, this patch is comprehensive, covering everything from visuals to balance and bugs, and I'm pretty happy with how things have come together so far (for a tiny game on a shoestring budget). 

A big part of that is because of the in-depth feedback I've gotten from players on the FromLefcourt Discord (the link can be found on the store page, if you'd like to join). So much of today's patch is a direct result of them, so I just wanted to take a moment to say [b]thank you![/b]

If you aren't interested in joining the Discord, I still try to look at feedback elsewhere. A couple of today's changes are the result of a recent review pointing out some typos I hadn't noticed, for instance.

Finally, this week also brings the game's price up to its full retail value of $3.49 USD (pending review). The game's price will not increase again.

[b]Looking Forward: [/b]Those hoping for more content, the next 2 major patches (0.90, and 1.00) will add new powers, augments, difficulties, and achievements. I expect to reach 1.00 some time in January 2025.  Until then, here's the patch notes for today:

[h3]Patch Notes for 0.80[/h3]

[b]Visual and Interface Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Weapons now each have unique idle animations
[*] The Ker'Plau Boss missiles are now animated
[*] Ker'Plau mines are now animated
[*] Added credits to the main menu.
[*] Added the FromLefcourt logo screen to the start.
[*] The placement dots (when placing a weapon) now turn into red X's if the placement is invalid for any reason
[*] When your active power is available the cursor will change visually when using mouse controls
[*] Added an indicator to track the Scrap of Theseus augment progress labeled "Scrap"
[*] Changed the Forger synergy tracker label to "Forge" to prevent confusion
[*] When you're at the maximum tech tier, it will no longer show a gold cost to upgrade further
[*] Gold bars begin flashing much sooner, but their duration is unchanged
[*] Gold Bars now have a shiny animation, and some small sparkle effects when they first land
[*] During combat the "Main Menu" button when paused will now say "Forfeit"
[*] I've started implementing the Data Codex which will track unlocked content, achievements, and weapons equipped. This feature is currently disabled but a new button on the main menu is now present. Hoping to enable this in Patch 0.90.
[/list]

[b]Text Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Added flavor text for the remaining 13 augments that didn't have some
[*] Corrected outdated text related to your bench that had lingered since a much earlier version of the game
[*] Fixed Scrap of Theseus Typos in both the description and flavor texts
[*] Fixed typo in the Starwhal descriptions
[*] Fixed typo in the Long Wave descriptions
[/list]

[b]Sound Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a sound effect for shifting weapons in a column
[*] When your active power is available a sound will play
[*] Farlight's sound has been toned down to a softer, quieter effect. When multiple Farlights are active, the sound will not play as often.
[/list]

[b]Control Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now press escape to open and close the pause menu when using Mouse controls (does not currently work when confirming/cancelling a forfeit)
[*] Added a power shortcut-key when using mouse/keyboard controls. 
[*] Note: I am hoping to add rebinds for the shortcut keys in the upcoming 0.90 patch. These keys weren't originally planned, so adding rebinds requires a considerable update to the options menu.
[/list]

[b]Optimization[/b]
[list]
[*] Made optimizations to how enemy behaviors are handled.
[*] Fixed issues with the Negascope that caused slowdown when attempting to find a target, especially when multiple were on screen at once
[/list]

[b]Balance Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Forfeiting a game during combat will now grant post-game experience    
[*] Reduced experience cap to 450 from 600, making later unlocks happen faster
[*] Increased experience gain at higher difficulties from +10% to +20% each
[*] Ker'Plau will no longer place as many mines, and mines can no longer stack on the same space
[*] The Double Down augment will now affect the Recycle Doc power.
[*] The Forger synergy no longer counts weapons that are destroyed as part of the wave ending
[*] The Forger synergy will no longer create a gold bar after a wave has ended
[*] Weapons above tier 1 now give less gold when fully upgraded. They now give back only the cost of 2 of the combined weapons instead of 3 (minus 1 gold).
[*] Breakthroughs have been adjusted to give less value overall. The value given previously made managing your economy relatively trivial. Breakthrough can give variable amounts based on your current tech tier (1-3, 4-6, 7-9).
[*] Value Share: Now grants 2/2/3 gold value, down from 2/3/4
[*] Rebait: Now grants 1/1/2 gold bars instantly, down from 1/2/3
[*] Guidance: Now grants 2/2/3 free rerolls, down from 2/3/4
[*] Salvage: Now says "grants 4x its tech tier in gold" instead of "2x its sell value."
[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Resolved some issues when tabbing out at specific moments during the end game phase that could soft-lock the game
[*] If you open the pause menu during game over, clicking resume will no longer restart enemy movements
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause some enemies to get stuck at the end of their attack animation
[*] Fixed an issue that could allow some enemies to attack weapons that just shifted out of their targeting area for a single attack
[*] Fixed a bug preventing Value Share from triggering properly
[*] The Choosinator augment will now grant a free reroll immediately upon equipping it, and will no longer wait until the end of the next round
[*] The Bullet Buddy will no longer create an infinite amount of visual fx when trying to place a drone on a weapon that already has one. The FX will now trigger on the targeted weapon and only when possible to create the drone.
[*] Fixed a bug that was causing certain beam hitboxes to become visible
[*] Scrap Drones should now spawn with the correct frequency chance.
[*] Fixed an issue with the forfeit confirmation that would trigger the last highlighted menu option even if the player clicked elsewhere
[*] When weapons have had their base value increased by a breakthrough, and they are upgraded, their bonus value should now be properly retained
[*] When a weapon is optimized by a breakthrough, the icon will now properly appear on the weapon when you load a saved game
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.70
notes.content:
The Ker'Plau have arrived! Their ships aren't particularly durable, but their specialty is long range attacks that whittle your own weapons down. I hope this brings a lot more variety to future runs, and encourages players to try different strategies.

There's likely more balancing to do, but after some test runs and feedback, I think they're in a good place to release now. They'll also be receiving some audio and visual polish in the next patch, so consider this 1.0 of Ker'Plau, but 2.0 is on its way, and I welcome your feedback before then.

[b]Speaking of the next patch: [/b] You can expect the entire game to get some audio and visual updates, a number of lingering UI issues will be addressed, and I'm working on implementing some community requested quality of life features.

And just [b]a reminder that the price will be going up to its final retail price of $3.49 USD[/b] (regional pricing applies) around when 0.80 releases. With the release of the third faction, now is a great time to buy the game at a discount if you've been waiting to pick it up!

And as always, if you've been enjoying your time with Cosmic Raze, please leave a review!

[h3]Patch Notes for 0.70[/h3]

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] The Ker'plau have been added as an enemy faction
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150731/4c3af0799c746d5fb54d1c88dcabf0784354a784.jpg[/img]
- 5 new standard enemies
- 2 new hard enemies at difficulty 2+
- 1 new elite enemy
- 1 new final boss
[*] Difficulty 5 has been added: -1 choices for all shop options. Maximum of 5 choices. Reroll base cost is now 2 gold. Includes previous difficulty modifiers.
[/list]

[b]New Achievements[/b]
[list]
[*] Razer V: Beat Difficulty 5
[*] Hat Trick: Beat every faction's final boss at least once
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Hot Spring is now correctly taking damage when spawning mines. Should also now *not* take damage when Panic Button is active.
[*] Fixed an issue where reroll costs would not update until deselecting and reselecting the reroll button
[*] Fixed an issue with the "Corner Cutter" augment applying the energy discount to the old cost of units (from earlier versions) instead of the updated one, causing it to reduce by much less.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.70 Preview and Beyond
notes.content:
Patch 0.70 is taking a little longer than I expected so I thought I'd make a little patch preview to update the expected release time, and talk about what's coming.

[b]First:[/b] I originally expected to have the patch ready by today, but some unexpected life events have slowed me down. I'm still hoping to have the next big patch out by mid next week, but feedback on balance will dictate the exact release.

Limited testing will likely start later today in the beta branch, but if you're looking for a balanced, complete experience, I'd suggest waiting until the full release.

[h3]So what's in the patch?[/h3]
It goes without saying, but [b]the main focus of 0.70 will be the 3rd enemy faction[/b], The Ker'Plau. They're a low health, but long range faction that will slowly whittle you down if you're not careful. They bring a lot of new mechanics to the game, and once the right balance is achieved, should help diversify which builds people are playing, depending on the faction composition. The faction will include:
[list]
[*] 5 new standard enemies
[*] 2 new hard enemies at difficulty 2+
[*] 1 new elite enemy
[*] 1 new final boss
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150731/e2ec7c41f68c9b9c0d7294657505113939f07e39.png[/img]
In addition to that, I'm planning to add Difficulty level 5 (some players have already conquered the first 4!), and a couple achievements will be added related to these updates.

[b]Important Note: [/b]Some time after patch 0.70, on or before 0.80, I'll be increasing the price of Cosmic Raze from $2.49 to its final release price of $3.49 (regional pricing applies).

[h3]What's coming up after this patch?[/h3]
The Cosmic Raze Early Access period was always planned to be a short one, but there's still plenty of content to come! Below are the major milestones planned, but I expect smaller updates and hotfixes in between. 
[list]
[*] [b]Patch 0.80[/b] will be a big polish patch. Not the most exciting thing, but it will add tons of new animations, effects, and sounds, as well as some community requested quality of life features.
[*] [b]Patch 0.90[/b] will be a big achievement patch, and will also add difficulty levels 6, 7, and 8.
[*] [b]Patch 1.00[/b] will be the biggest content update to the game and will add a pile of new active and passive augments, and even more achievements. I want to save the biggest content patch for last so players who've been testing and giving feedback along the way will have a lot of new stuff to check out on release.
[/list]
[h3]When is 1.00 expected to release?[/h3]
Currently, I'm on track for a January 2025 release date. The circumstances surrounding the patch 0.70 delay are unique, and I'm not anticipating anything else like it (knock on wood...if I were superstitious)

If you have ideas for augments, achievements, or even difficulty levels, I'm still open to suggestions. You can post in the appropriate forum here on Steam, or in the FromLefcourt Discord.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.61.5
notes.content:
A few quick fixes to saving and loading games. 

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] If you save and quit while in the augment or breakthrough selection menu, the game will now properly remember the last generated weapon choices as well, and load them back in after you make your selection. Previously, you could end up with an empty shop after making an augment/breakthrough selection, and be forced to reroll.
[*] (Mouse only) Fixed an issue when loading in the above scenario, where it could be hard or impossible to select the top menu buttons with the mouse.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the level 2 "Fire Holes" from adding an extra targeter.
[/list]

notes.title: Balance Update and Bug Fix 0.61.2
notes.content:
I tend to release updates for my games fairly quickly, but this isn't typical even for me. Normally I'd let this patch marinate in the beta branch for a couple days, because there's some significant balance changes, but I had to release it now because of a game-breaking bug that allowed the weapon limit to be exceeded, and I was too deep in this next update to go back to an older version.

[b]Patch 0.61.2[/b]
[list]
[*] Balance: This update adjusts the relative power of weapons by shifting more power into the higher tier weapons, both by making them less expensive to build, and by giving them more sustain and damage. Tier 1 weapons, also subject to the reduced energy costs, are now more fragile.
[*] Weapons across all tiers and levels have had their energy costs reduced
[*] Weapon: Bullet Buzz: Level 1 health now 25, and level 2 now 50. Cooldown up to 1.85 seconds (from 1.5), and 1.65 seconds at level 2.
[*] Weapon: Ion Sight: Level 1 health now 25, level 2 unchanged
[*] Weapon: Starwhal: Level 1 health now 40, level 2 unchanged
[*] Weapon: Sunsplitter: Level 1 can now target up to 4 enemies and level 2 can target up to 5. +20 health at level 1 and 2.
[*] Weapon: Every Fling: +15 health at level 1 and 2, and cooldown at level 1 reduced from 3 seconds to 2.5 seconds. Level 2 cooldown is now 2.25 seconds.
[*] Weapon: Upcharge: +25 health at level 1 and 2. +15 damage at level 1. +15 damage at level 2.
[*] Weapon: Farlight: +20 health, +3 damage per beam. Cooldown reduced from 7 seconds to 5. Fires 3 times per second while the drone is active up from 2. Now creates a drone immediately upon being built.
[*] Weapon: Thunder Jumper: +20 health at level 1 and 2, +5 damage at level 1, bombs now travel slightly faster.
[*] Augment: Corner Cutter: Now reduces energy cost and build cooldowns by 25% down from 30%. Weapons now spawn with 25% of their normal health.
[*] Enemies: The new enemies have all had their health, speed, and attack damage tweaked in small ways
[/list]

Bugs
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that was causing the weapon limit counter to stop counting after 13, allowing for too many weapons to be built at lower tech tiers
[*] Mouse Only: Fixed a bug that was preventing the difficulty tooltip from updating
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.60.1
notes.content:
A few quick updates on some lingering issues.

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that was preventing Breakthroughs from unlocking post-game. Other upgrade unlocks were working fine. This fix will restore missing unlocks to your save file when you next start the game. If you've leveled up previously and not seen an upgrade icon, this was the problem.
[*] Continuing to work on Sun Power targeting desync issues. This issue can cause Sun Power targets to fail to be destroyed, and fail to remain on targets for the full duration. I've found and fixed more than one issue related to this, and It isn't currently happening in my tests, but could take more testing to isolate further issues. It's a hard to replicate bug (at least consistently)
[*] Fixed an issue where synergies were not counting when you loaded a game, until you selected and/or moved a weapon on your bench.
[*] The Recon synergy now correctly states 2/4 units needed, instead of 2/4/6
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.60
notes.content:
This week's update is all about adding more challenge beyond difficulty 1. Devious new enemies, and a dangerous new difficulty should keep you more active in the late game.

While Early Access for Cosmic Raze is expected to be quite short, there's plenty of content and polish still to come in a series of 4 planned major updates. The first up will be adding the 3rd enemy faction: The Ker'Plau. After that expect a huge assortment of achievements, additional difficulty levels, audio/visual updates, and of course new augments and powers to equip!

I can't wait to get the Ker'Plau into the game for you all. They feel very different. I'm hoping to have that patch ready by late next week. [b]If you've been enjoying my little twist on tower defense, please leave a positive review, it helps a lot![/b]


[h3]Patch 0.60: Razing The Bar[/h3]

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] On difficulty 2+ new enemy types can show up for the primary faction after wave 7. The chance for these more dangerous enemies increases ever so slightly at every difficulty level.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150731/1ba6071fd00e0676eb6a818293c41cc204c0535d.gif[/img]
[*] Added difficulty level 4: Long range attacks target and destroy your weapons periodically. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150731/d1898f7dfa84e6521343d046a6fc8677928b60a6.gif[/img]
[*] Added 3 new achievements for beating the higher difficulties currently available. You'll need to beat the difficulties again if you already have because balance has changed significantly.
- Razer II: Beat Difficulty 2
- Razer III: Beat Difficulty 3
- Razer IV: Beat Difficulty 4
[/list]

[b]QoL[/b]
[list]
[*] Added tooltip text that indicates what breakthrough has been applied to a weapon
[*] Mouse: The continue button highlights and makes a sound on selection at the end of a wave/game
[*] Mouse: Fixed a major oversight that prevented the weapon upgrade tooltip from showing up in shop when navigating with the mouse instead of a gamepad. Sorry to everyone that couldn't see some very vital information!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150731/7d5c7113961884d8538bf9b0b38597fb7cb472c3.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Weapon: Hot Spring now places a mine at a random unoccupied position, a minimum of 4 grid spaces away. It now places its first mine instantly upon being created. Damage decreased to 40 from 45 at level 2. It now starts with 40 health, down from 60. *Notes: Fixed a bug that was preventing it from applying burn. So while many of its stats have been nerfed, its ability to actually apply burn, coupled with placing its first mine instantly should balance that out.*
[*] Plasmic burn is now chance based to apply. Various weapons and augments have been updated with their own chance values.
[*] Weapon: Fire Holes now deals no immediate damage (previously 10), but has 100% plasmic chance. Now counts as a defense unit and not an assault.
[*] Augment: Fire Wall now has a 40% chance to apply plasmic burn.
[*] Augment: Hot Potato now has a 20% chance to apply burn
[*] Weapon: Slow Cooker now has a 40% chance to apply plasmic burn at level 1, and gains +20% chance at level 2.
[*] Weapon: Sparkholder now has a 50% chance to apply plasmic burn at level 1, and gains +50% chance at level 2.
[*] Enemy: The Smorg Elite (Caterpillar) segments are now always destroyed on each weapon impact, 1 at a time.
[*] Enemy: Smorg Orb Weavers (spinning orbs around them) have +20 health
[*] Enemy: Smorg Spawners (create stationary targets in random spaces) have +20 health
[*] Power: Panic Shield has a 24 second cooldown down from 25
[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug preventing Hot Spring from applying plasmic burn
[*] When you're at the current maximum level for unlocks, your exp will now remain at max and you will not continue to level up
[*] Fixed a bug with the 2nd level of the Defense Synergy that caused the bombs created to be placed in random locations
[*] Mouse Only: Fixed issues where you'd need to mouse off the current breakthrough and then mouse over again to select it when the menu first popped up
[*] Mouse Only: Fixed issues where you'd need to mouse off the current weapon and then mouse over again to select it after choosing a breakthrough or augment
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.57
notes.content:
This update is just about working through feedback, and making more adjustments to ease players in and smooth out higher (and future) difficulties. I'm pretty comfortable with where things are for the base difficulty now. There will be a few more updates between now and the new faction update that will add some new fun stuff to higher difficulties.

Finally, If you've reported a bug or made a request and I haven't addressed it yet, it's on the list, and I haven't forgotten about it.

[h3]Patch 0.57 Notes[/h3]

[b]Feature[/b]
[list]
[*] Wave Breaks: The wave timer now stops and a small countdown begins at the top of the screen before a Legion attacks. This starts at 3 seconds of extra buffer time (there was already a small buffer built in depending on how quickly you cleared enemies), and increases to 6 seconds by the late game. [i]Note: For many players this won't be a necessary feature at difficulty 1, but this will help smooth out the intro curve for new players, and for all players at higher levels of difficulty.[/i]
[/list]

[b]Polish[/b]
[list]
[*] Certain breakthroughs will now add letter icons to the affected weapons so you know which ones have which effects in the shop, but only when it matters. Note: I intend to add some text to the tooltip box, eventually.
- P for Prototype
- O for Optimized
- C for Capacity
[*] Level 2 weapons are now marked when placed in battle, so they can be told apart from level 1's
[*] Combat icons now properly show if the weapon is upgraded as well
[*] It's now explained in the difficulty 1 tooltip that higher difficulties increase your experience gained
[*] The plasmic tooltip now states the duration (3 seconds).
[*] Fixed a typo in the save and quit prompt
[*] Minor optimization to various bits of code (likely neglible on performance)
[/list]

[b]Balance[/b]
[i]Notes: Breakthroughs have gotten a tune up, moving more interesting options into the starter pool, and forward in the unlocks. These changes may result in you seeing certain breakthroughs unlock again, despite having unlocked them already due to the way unlocks work.[/i]
[list]
[*] Breakthrough: "Optimized" is a new breakthrough in the starter pool. It allows you to reduce the energy cost of the upgraded weapon by 12%
[*] Breakthrough: Trickle Down has been removed from the pool.
[*] Breakthrough: "Integrity" is now called "Value Share" and adds 2/3/4 gold to 1 weapon's value on your bench.
[*] Breakthrough: "Capacity" (allows you to place an extra copy of the upgraded weapon) is now in the starting pool, and does not need to be unlocked.
[*] Breakthrough: "Efficiency" (bonus energy gain) is now the first Breakthrough unlocked allowing it to be added to the pool many levels earlier.
[*] Breakthrough: "Salvage" (destroy your upgraded weapon for double its sell value) is now the 2nd breakthrough you'll unlock.
[*] Tech Tiers: Now grant +15% bonus energy gain (previously was 12% but the tooltip said 5%).
[*] Enemy attack timers no longer instantly reset if you shift lanes. There is a buffer that allows them to retarget a new weapon if one moves in front of them while they're still charging an attack.
[*] Enemies: Valknari Turtles disable weapons more frequently.
[*] Enemies: Valknari elites have +50 health, and attack 20% faster
[*] Synergy: The "Assault" synergy now grants a 12/20/36% chance to gain +1 bonus ammo on reload. Down from 20/35/50%.
[*] Weapons: Pellet Pulser now has a 1.5 second cooldown at level 1, and a 1.35 second cooldown at level 2.
[*] Weapon: Bullet Buddy now has no limit on drones placed on allies at one time, but the cooldown has been increased. Gains more health at level 2.
[*] Weapons: Voltic chain damage range has been reduced slightly, and the chance to apply voltic effects has been reduced to 20% from 25%.
[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] The reroll cost increase will now instantly be reflected in the shop without needing to reselect the reroll option when playing on difficulty 3+
[*] Fire Holes no longer says it deals bomb damage, nor does it list the gravic synergy
[*] Fixed an issue with Voltic damage triggering itself recursively
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause the star rating to disappear
[*] Satellite Strike should now properly hit all enemy types
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.55.1
notes.content: Just a quick fix for the level 2 upgrade of "Hot Spring" which accidentally had a cooldown of 0 seconds.

notes.title: Patch 0.55 Progress and Polish
notes.content:
It's time for a big patch, and it's all thanks to the wonderful feedback I've received here and on discord! Thanks so much to everyone for helping me make this game a better experience. As a solo dev, I just can't do this without you.

If you want to chat directly, give feedback, and see beta patch notes before they're on the main branch, I highly recommend the [url=https://discord.gg/YbdSHs58m9]FromLefcourt Discord, here.[/url]

If you want to help support my Byte Size Games initiative, get sneak previews of upcoming features and new games, and be featured in the credits on full release, [url=https://www.patreon.com/FromLefcourt]check out my Patreon, here.[/url]

And last, but, uh, most? [b]Please leave a review on Steam[/b] if you are enjoying the game. 15 reviews and 100% positive, but I need a couple more from direct Steam purchases to get an official rating. It's a huge help. To all of you that have already done so, thanks so much! It really does mean everything to me.

[b]What's next:[/b] Patch 0.65 will see the release of the Ker'plau, the third faction of evil invading aliens. I still have a few bug reports to address and plenty of audio/visual updates to release between now and then, but I don't think you'll be waiting too long for the new faction.

Now onto the notes! Let me know what you think in the comments.

[h3]Patch Notes for 0.55[/h3]


[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150731/a7958c185964c6adea4046ee848c2d4ccec5359b.png[/img]
[*] Added Saving/Loading. Because it's a roguelike there are some rules to how this works. If you try to quit during combat you will forfeit your run and your save will be lost. You may only save and resume from the shop phase. There are warnings and explanations built into the menus so you don't accidentally forget.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150731/2ae2cb3fa808ca5fa7658e82ce5982e12c941bc0.png[/img]
[*] You can now press 1-5 to quickly select a weapon slot when using mouse controls only. These can not currently be rebound, but you can use either set of numbers if your keyboard has a numpad. A tutorial tip has been added for this.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150731/871436b48d40853e3c67c825ad853519705051b7.png[/img]
[/list]
[b]Polish[/b]
[list]
[*] QoL: The difficulty will default to your last played setting when you return to the main menu
[*] Visual: Valknari "Turtle" attacks now create a "Disabled" prompt over the weapons they disable with their barrier attacks.
[*] Visual: Cram Shell has a visual effect when triggered
[*] Visual: Panic Shield has a visual effect when triggered.[i] Note: a persistent effect that lasts for the duration is planned for a future update[/i]
[*] Visual: Column Bomb has a unique mine sprite now
[*] Audio/Visual: Backup Battery has an audio and visual effect when triggered
[*] Text: Added more flavor texts to augments that didn't yet have them (but not all of them)
[*] Text: Breakthrough: "Trickle Down" typos fixed
[*] Text: Enabled a tutorial tip that explains gold interest at the end of the first wave
[*] Text: Mouse controls have some unique tutorial tips that make more sense for how the interface is utilized. 
[*] Text: The tutorial tip for collecting gold bars now explains that you can not collect gold while in shift mode
[*] Text: Added missing text that explains "Bullet Buddy" can only have a maximum number of active drones.
[/list]

[b]Balance: [/b] [i]This is the first big balance update based on what I'm seeing. Drones and Bombs got a little love this patch, but this is only the start for them. There are numerous Augments planned for the upgrade pool to help them further.
The Valknari enemies also got some changes to help with their identity. They're supposed to be lumbering, bigger enemies, that are strong against small, direct attacks, but weaker against abilities that can get around shields, as well as slows and disables.[/i]
[list]
[*] Difficulty 2: Now scales 10% at start, then again on waves 5, 10, and 15  for a total of +40%. The 50% total increase seemed too punishing for difficulty level 2 for a lot of players. I may reduce this further depending on feedback. There are a lot of difficulty levels left to add, after all.
[*] Valknari: Some Valknari had a stat that wasn't officially implemented, giving them stealth damage reduction. Against things that did lots of super small instances of damage, like Sun Power and Slow Cooker, they were effectively invincible. This is no longer the case.
[*] Enemy: Sea Slug (basic Valknari) shield is now farther forward and a bit thicker. This should prevent odd collision issues where damage it should block could sneak through by a pixel and hit the ship itself.
[*] Enemy: Valknari Ram now charges from farther away, and bounces back farther on impact.  +40 health, -50% base move speed.
[*] Enemy: Valknari Hammerheads have +30 health, but their shields have -20 health. They now get an extra layer of shield after wave 8 that blocks an additional 80 damage.
[*] Enemy: Valknari Turtles now attack 10% faster, and have +20 health.
[*] Breakthrough: "Spare Parts" now only ever grants 1 extra level 1 of a weapon. At higher tech tier levels it used to grant 2 copies. [i]Note: While some breakthroughs get stronger by offering extra effects as your tech tier increases, some get stronger simply because they affect more powerful weapons. This falls more into the latter category, as getting extra copies of higher tier weapons is bonus enough.[/i]
[*] Weapon: Bullet Buzz now has reduced attack range, and 13% longer cooldown
[*] Weapon: Wing Mandroid now takes 10 damage and heals for 15, allowing it to heal a bit more, and making its own health more valuable. Note: A number of weapons that once expended charges now expend health, making Wing Mandroid more valuable overall. This does not apply to drones, only weapons, but it could apply to the weapons that create the drones.
[*] Weapon: Cluster Shock now launches 2 sets of 2 bombs, targeting grids 3 and 4 spaces away instead of targeting a single grid space. Damage per bomb has been increased by 4 at both levels.
[*] Weapon: Droidle now deals 12 damage per attack down from 16, but the drones have +2 attack charges at level 1. At level 2 they now gain +20% attack range, and +50% drone speed.
[*] Weapon: Bullet Buddy now has a maximum of 3 active drones at a time at level 2, up from 2.
[*] Weapon: Hot Spring now targets the farthest space with no mine in it, and instead of losing charges, loses health. It creates mines faster, and create more before being destroyed, but deals 30 damage in an area, down from 45.
[*] Weapon: Outfielder now recharges in 3 seconds once a bomb has been destroyed, down from 4. +5 damage at both levels.
[*] Weapon: The "Light Touch" has had its range reduced to 4 from 6. It now gains +1 range at level 2. Now also has a 1.66 second cooldown up from 1 second, and a 1.5 second cooldown at level 2. [i]Notes: This weapon was reaching too far by default given that it can also attack adjacent lanes, and was putting out way too much damage for a level 2 weapon. It's still one of the best weapons, but a little less perfect.[/i]
[*] Synergy: Utility now grants +15% cooldown reduction, up from 10%
[*] Synergy: Sniper now requires 3/5 units up from 2/4
[*] Synergy: Laser now gives 8/16/32% chance to deal 35% bonus damage, down from 10/20/35% to deal 50% bonus.
[*] Synergy: Drones now have a 20/40% chance to create a scrap drone, up from 15/35%.
[*] Synergy: Bombs now gain a 30/60% chance to apply plasmic burn instead of the 15/25% explosion radius (which did very little in effective damage).
[*] Synergy: Bullet piercing now correctly reduces damage by 25% per target hit. [i]Notes: Technically a bug fix, but will impact balance considerably. I was previously planning to make a lot of adjustments to bullet weapons, as they're some of the strongest, but with this fix, I'm going to wait and see now.[/i]
[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Synergy: Corrected a number of incorrect synergy tags on some defense weapons
[*] Synergy: Fixed a bug that was preventing the Defense synergy from triggering
[*] Synergy: Gravic and knockback effects should no longer be able to push enemies up (and off the screen)
[*] Power: Satellite Strike is now only targeting 1 space...for real this time.
[*] Mouse: The "Power" text on the UI now properly disappears at the end of a wave
[*] Mouse: Fixed a bug that would cause the difficulty menu to deselect when you tried clicking the arrows to change it
[*] Enemy: Fixed a bug that wouldn't allow Valknari Turtle ships to disable weapons in the front most row.
[*] Weapon: Fixed a bug that could cause the Wing Mandroid to stop healing
[*] Breakthroughs: Fixed a bug causing incorrect text for certain breakthroughs depending on your tech tier
[*] Text: Tier 4 units now display the correct stats when upgraded
[*] UI: Tier 4 units now properly display the upgrade icon when upgraded
[*] UI: The Victory/Game Over screens will now display the correct Difficulty [i](the difficulty settings were being properly applied everywhere else)[/i]
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.51.2
notes.content:
[h3]Patch 0.51.2[/h3]
Happy Sunday! I'm continuing to smooth out some remaining rough edges, and have a few more updates coming in that regard, but happy with progress. With the most important issues resolved (I think), I'm focusing on finishing up the save/resume game systems for hopefully later this week.

As always, if you're enjoying the game please leave a review. The feedback so far has been really encouraging, but gotta get a few more reviews so the game can get its first, all important, official rating.


[b]Onto the notes:[/b]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with the assault synergy that could cause it to give ammo to non-assault abilities (including augments) while they were reloading. This would cause them to get stuck reloading, and in the case of augments could permanently disable them.
[*] Fixed an issue that would cause enemy bullets from the Valknari Elite ship to become intangible, unable to collide with weapons or disappear
[*] Fixed a bug that was preventing the "Weapons Upgraded" stat from properly updating post-game
[*] (Mouse Only) Fixed a bug that would cause you to be unable to highlight the first augment after upgrading until you moused over a different augment
[/list]
[b]QoL[/b]
[list]
[*] Forger Synergy Gold Spawn Sound should no longer be too loud
[*] Drone and Recon synergy units needed now match the tooltip text
[*] (Mouse Only) You no longer need to left click to make the cursor reappear when quitting or restarting to the main menu 
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.51.1
notes.content:
Because I'm a workaholic I put together another patch before I head out. Have been testing all morning, and everything seems stable. I really am leaving until tomorrow now. Really.

Oh, and if you're enjoying the game, please leave a review. Word of mouth is a huge help in these early days and getting to 10 reviews from direct Steam purchases is really important.


[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]

[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Power: Panic Shield now lasts for 4 seconds
[*] Enemy: The Basic Valknari ship ("Sea Slug") has 15 more health on the shield, but 10 less health on the ship itself.
[*] Enemy: The Valknari "Armordillo" (one step above the basic ship) now has +20 health and +5 damage, but moves and charges its attack a little slower.
[/list]
[b]QoL[/b]
[list]
[*] Negascope has a quieter, less intrusive sound
[*] Harvester synergy text has been updated with the correct synergy info.
[/list]
[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that would lock the game if you opened the pause menu at the "Wave End" screen in combat
[*] Panic Shield now correctly protects against all types of damage.
[*] Callback now properly counts as a sweeping weapon
[*] Added a fix to hopefully prevent rare instances where waves simply won't end. [i]This may take more investigating, but hopefully it helps.[/i]
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.50.4
notes.content:
Okay, one more hotfix for the evening. That's IT! If you want the latest builds as I update, before they're fully polished and tested, you can always join the beta branch. It's open to anyone.  Okay, back Sunday! Enjoy!

[list]
[*] Fixed the Merry Go Rounds augment, so it applies to all weapons properly instead of just 1 or some
[*] Fixed the Cool Shift augment, so it applies to all weapons properly instead of just 1 or some
[*] Updated the Missile synergy to have the correct text and stats
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Far Light weapon to create the Up Charge in battle
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.50.2
notes.content:
A couple more quick fixes for the day.

[list]
[*] Mouse Only: Fixed an issue where switching directly from shifting to using a power could lock the cursor/targeter until you right clicked.
[*] Fixed an issue with Satellite Strike being able to target the whole screen due to a debug test I left on.
[/list]

That should cover things for now. Back Sunday!

notes.title: Patch 0.50
notes.content:
I'm listening to the early feedback here, and on Discord, and this first patch should address some of the rough edges for many of you, with more to come!

I won't be around tomorrow, as a friend is taking me out for a late birthday/launch celebration, but I'll be back at it and working on the next patch on Sunday. As for what's up next? You can always check the roadmap in the forums to see all the planned features, but the first major patch will include the ability to save and resume from your last shop phase (if you don't die). 

Now, onto the patch notes!

[h3]Patch 0.50[/h3]

[b]QoL[/b]
[list]
[*] Added an alert pop-up system that will show why you can't build a weapon. Only one alert will show at a time, even if there are multiple reasons, to avoid clutter. It tries to prioritize the most important reason to the circumstance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150731/b732986e65dacdcea42322bc732baa31d227a341.gif[/img]
[*] When you're targeting an invalid space, the grid now displays a white "X" on top of the red color change.
[*] Cooldown timers are now easier to see on top of the weapon and power icons
[*] Fixed various typos in weapon and augment texts
[*] Chronomurder now highlights both Gravic and Voltic synergies
[/list]

[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Satellite Strike (unlockable) power now has a larger area of effect. Was previously missing enemies outside of the dead center of the targeted grid space.
[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Mouse Only: If you click on a targeted power immediately after clicking on a weapon in the build bar, it will no longer instantly activate (untargeted powers will still activate instantly).
[*] Cursor dots should no longer become permanently invisible.
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause the game to get stuck, unable to proceed if a tutorial tip triggered at the exact end of the first wave (such as the first time an enemy collides with Earth, or the first time a Gold Bar appears, and a few others).
[*] The "Salvage" Breakthrough will now correctly give the full value for Tier 1 units.
[*] "Reserve Bank" should now give the correct amount of gold
[*] When you get the higher level versions of the Breakthrough "Spare Parts" it should no longer place the extra units on top of occupied spaces.
[*] The "Satellite Strike" power will no longer hit enemies in the center of the grid spaces above the targeted space
[*] The "Trap Card" power should no longer radnomly (seemingly) stop working on activation.
[*] Fixed a typo that was preventing the achievement, "Super Starter" from unlocking
[/list]
